title: Stationary diagonal quasi-free variational bottom stays on the N^4 scale

variational_boundary.restricted_bottom: Let E_N^qf be the infimum of q0+g int W_N over normalized stationary translation-invariant diagonal quasi-free Gaussian trials with constant mean. K1525 gives E_N^qf>=c_gN^4 for fixed g>0
variational_boundary.vacuum_upper: The vacuum is in the class and has Rayleigh quotient 6gC_N^2=O(N^4), hence E_N^qf=Theta_g(N^4)
variational_boundary.route_decision: The order-N^2 upper wake left by K1519 cannot be met by a covariance-preserving coherent shift or by this stationary diagonal quasi-free squeeze class
variational_boundary.surviving_routes: A matching trial, if it exists, must use structure outside the classified class, such as genuinely non-Gaussian correlations, a nonstationary or off-diagonal Gaussian covariance, or another nonlinear form-domain construction; none is constructed here
variational_boundary.restricted_recentering: Every a_N=o(N^4) leaves all Rayleigh quotients in the classified quasi-free class divergent to plus infinity, but this restricted statement is not an operator spectral or resolvent bound because the full form domain is larger
variational_boundary.brst_transfer: Tensoring a classified matter trial with a harmonic BRST vector preserves its Rayleigh quotient, so the same restricted N^4 trial-class boundary transfers to harmonic compression without constraining general BRST states or constructing a continuum charge
variational_boundary.unrestricted_corridor: The true unrestricted ground energy still obeys only K1519's c_gN^2 lower bound and the existing one-sided upper results; its asymptotic, localization, compactness and Mosco recovery remain open
